Will I get a replacement or a refund?
Whether you receive a refund or a replacement depends on your situation:
Change of mind / standard return: If your unused, sealed order from our website is returned in full within 28 days (including complimentary gifts), you are eligible for a refund; shipping back is at your expense.
Exchange request: For eligible website orders (unused, original packaging, within 28 days), we can exchange the product for one of equal or lower value.
Damaged on arrival: If your product arrives damaged, our team will review your case and may arrange a replacement or other solution after you contact us and provide photos.
Functional defect with the bottle: For defects on items bought on our official website, our customer support will assess your request and may offer a replacement or refund in line with our policies.
To know exactly what applies to your order, please contact us via the online contact form so our customer care team can review your specific case and confirm whether a refund or replacement is possible.
